adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler, the request body is validated with `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` (throws on invalid input), then decrypted via `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")`, and then `JSON.parse(...)` is called on the decrypted string. None of these operations are wrapped in a try/catch or use non-throwing `safeParse`, so malformed JSON bodies, invalid/encrypted payloads, or decryption failures will throw and surface as an unhandled 500 instead of a controlled 4xx (e.g., 400). This is directly verifiable from the diff.
